name: zopt_display_section_set_target_display
description: zOpt::DisplaySection_SetTargetDisplay stores the display-section display node and applies the active display rectangle to the target display.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this view-rectangle helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zOpt/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4085b0 validates storing the target at display-section offset 0x24, doing nothing further for a null target, and applying width/height through gwDisplaySetSize plus x/y through gwDisplaySetPosition for a non-null target.
The native smoke verifies target storage and propagated display size/origin fields.
